question: 设 $\lambda_0$ 为 $n$ 阶矩阵 $A$ 的 $k$ 重特征根，证明 $A$ 对应于 $\lambda_0$ 的线性无关特征向量的个数不大于 $k$
answer: $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{l},\alpha_{l+1},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 构成 $R^{n}$ 的一个基，则 $A\alpha_{i}(i=1,2,\cdots,n)$ 可由这个基线性表示。设有

steps.text:
设 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{l}$ 是 A 对应于特征值 $\lambda_{0}$ 的线性无关特征向量，添加向量 $\alpha_{l+1},\alpha_{l+2},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ ，使得 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{l},\alpha_{l+1},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 构成 $R^{n}$ 的一个基，则 $A\alpha_{i}(i=1,2,\cdots,n)$ 可由这个基线性表示。设有

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} A \alpha_ {1} = \lambda_ {0} \alpha_ {1}, \\ \vdots \\ A \alpha_ {l} = \lambda_ {0} \alpha_ {l}, \\ A \alpha_ {l + 1} = k _ {l + 1, l} \alpha_ {1} + \dots + k _ {l + 1, l} \alpha_ {l} + \dots + k _ {l + 1, n} \alpha_ {n}, \\ \vdots \\ A \alpha_ {n} = k _ {n, l} \alpha_ {1} + \dots + k _ {n, l} \alpha_ {l} + \dots + k _ {n, n} \alpha_ {n}. \end{array} \right.
$$

即

$$
A \left(\alpha_ {1}, \dots , \alpha_ {l}, \alpha_ {l + 1}, \dots , \alpha_ {n}\right) = \left(\alpha_ {1}, \dots , \alpha_ {l}, \alpha_ {l + 1}, \dots , \alpha_ {n}\right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c c} \lambda_ {0} & & & k _ {1, l + 1} & \dots & k _ {1, n} \\ & \ddots & & \vdots & & \vdots \\ & & \lambda_ {0} & k _ {l, l + 1} & \dots & k _ {l, n} \\ 0 & \dots & 0 & k _ {l + 1, l + 1} & \dots & k _ {l + 1, n} \\ \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 0 & \dots & 0 & k _ {n, l + 1} & \dots & k _ {n, n} \end{array} \right).
$$

记 $(\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{l},\alpha_{l+1},\cdots,\alpha_{n})=P$ ，则P可逆，上式为

$$
\boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} {\lambda_ {0}} & & {0} & \\ & {\ddots} & & {*} \\ {0} & & {\lambda_ {0}} & \\ & & & {A _ {1}} \end{array} \right) (A _ {1} \text {是} n - l \text {阶矩阵}).\tag{①}
$$

因此

$$
\lambda I - P ^ {- 1} A P = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} \lambda - \lambda_ {0} & & & \\ & \ddots & & * \\ & & \lambda - \lambda_ {0} & \\ & & & \lambda I _ {1} - A _ {1} \end{array} \right).
$$

由于相似矩阵有相同的特征多项式，所以

$$
\left| \lambda I - A \right| = \left| \lambda I - P ^ {- 1} A P \right| = \left(\lambda - \lambda_ {0}\right) ^ {\prime} \left| \lambda I _ {1} - A _ {1} \right|.
$$
这说明 $(\lambda - \lambda_0)'$ 是矩阵 $A$ 的特征多项式的因式，而 $k$ 是特征根 $\lambda_0$ 的代数重数，所以 $l \leqslant k$ .

meta.syllabus_note: 几何重数不大于代数重数*
meta.commentary:
评注（1）该题的结论即为“矩阵特征值的几何重数不大于它的代数重数”.

(2) 由①式，用数学归纳法容易得到以下结论：

①任一n阶方阵均与上三角矩阵相似.

② 实对称矩阵一定相似于对角矩阵（取 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{l},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 为正交基即可）。因而两实对称矩阵相似的充分必要条件是它们有相同的特征值。
